answer: Re-attestations are stored in knoll and saffron lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the quill graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 3 dollars and 2 days per identity, which turns a 2096 account sybil into a 5 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
